Comment: RecallIndia IngestStateMachine (SPEC section Ingest pipeline). Init -> Fetch -> [FetchOk] -> Extract -> [ExtractOk] -> Normalise -> [NormaliseOk] -> Diff -> [DiffOk] -> Publish -> [Published] -> Done. Two CDSCO adapters, one Notice shape: cdsco_portal (live JSON, skips Extract) and cdsco_pdf (archive PDF: Textract TABLES primary, pdfplumber fallback). Every task stores its result under its own key ($.fetch, $.extract, $.normalise, $.diff, $.publish) and reads the earlier ones through cdsco_extract.pipeline_event (nested first, top-level input wins). No Task carries Parameters: the whole state is the input, so nothing ever references a missing path. Handlers never raise on an upstream failure: they return {degraded: true, error}, so after every task a Choice routes $.<step>.degraded == true to RecordFailure (the same short-circuit the DEMO runner applies); a thrown error lands there through the Catch with $.error. RecordFailure (Publish with $.error or a degraded step) writes meta#cdsco_pdf ok=false and the ingest#<run_id> record, then Failed.

Init.Comment: Stamp the execution identity onto the state: $.run = {execution_arn, execution_name, started_at}. Handlers derive the run id (common.ingest_runs.run_from_event -> last ':' segment of execution_arn) and write ingest#<run_id> progress rows that GET /ingest/status/{arn} reads.

Fetch.Comment: Input keys (all optional): adapter ('pdf' default | 'portal'), pdf_url, num_id, month, lab_scope ('cdsco' default | 'state'), force. cdsco_pdf: scrape the cdsco.gov.in Alerts listing, resolve download_file_division.jsp -> iframe src -> PDF, download to the raw bucket, write meta#cdsco_pdf (listing, last_fetch, ingested); output {source, adapter: 'cdsco_pdf', title, month, lab_scope, pdf_url, pdf_s3_key, num_id, is_new, bytes, listing_count, monthly_count, degraded, took_ms}. cdsco_portal: newest month -> {adapter: 'cdsco_portal', month, rows_in}. Never raises: upstream failure -> {degraded: true, error}.

FetchOk.Comment: Fetch never raises: $.fetch.degraded == true (listing unreachable, no monthly NSQ alert for the requested month, download failed) goes to RecordFailure so Extract cannot fall back to a default PDF and the execution ends FAILED. Portal rows are already tabular, so $.fetch.adapter == 'cdsco_portal' goes straight to Normalise; everything else (the PDF adapter) goes through Extract.

Extract.Comment: Reads pdf_s3_key / pdf_url / month from $.fetch and the run id from $.run. Textract StartDocumentAnalysis TABLES on RAW_BUCKET/pdf_s3_key, polled with backoff (3 s x1.5, cap 15 s, up to 240 s) and heartbeated to ingest#<run_id> every poll; rows rebuilt from CELL blocks with page + bbox. On any Textract exception (incl. SubscriptionRequiredException) or < 5 rows: pdfplumber find_tables fallback with per-row bboxes. Persists {method, header, rows, pages, pdf_s3_key} to <pdf_s3_key>.rows.json. Output {adapter, pdf_s3_key, pdf_url, month, pages, method: 'textract'|'pdfplumber', fallback_used, error, textract, header, rows_in, rows_s3_key, run_id, degraded, took_ms} plus rows inline when <= 200 KB. Single attempt (Retry MaxAttempts 0 = no retry; the Catch still records the failure): a Textract/pdfplumber run is long and a retry doubles the cost. Never raises on an upstream failure: {degraded: true, error} -> ExtractOk -> RecordFailure.

ExtractOk.Comment: $.extract.degraded == true (PDF missing from the raw bucket, both engines failed) goes to RecordFailure; otherwise Normalise.

Normalise.Comment: Reads adapter/month/pdf_s3_key/pdf_url from $.fetch and header/rows/rows_s3_key from $.extract (portal: fetches its rows itself). Bedrock (Nova Lite, temperature 0, strict JSON, batches of 25) only when BEDROCK_ENABLED and access works; header-keyword mapping (common.cdsco.rows_to_notices) is the fallback and the default today. Upserts notices (source cdsco_nsq, adapter, row_ref {page,row} PDF / {month,row} portal, pdf_s3_key, source_confidence primary-official) via common.notices.upsert_notice. Output {adapter, month, pdf_s3_key, pdf_url, rows_in, notices_out, counts: {created, updated, unchanged, upserted}, fallback_used: {extract, normalise}, bedrock: {enabled, attempted, used, error}, source_confidence, run_id, degraded, took_ms}. Single attempt (Retry MaxAttempts 0 = no retry; the Catch still records the failure): re-running re-reads every row and re-invokes Bedrock. Never raises on an upstream failure: {degraded: true, error} -> NormaliseOk -> RecordFailure.

NormaliseOk.Comment: $.normalise.degraded == true (no rows to map, an unrecognised month, the table unreachable) goes to RecordFailure; otherwise Diff.

Diff.Comment: cdsco_publish.diff_handler: new vs existing for this run from $.normalise.counts -> {new: created, updated, existing: unchanged, total: notices_out, month, previous: meta#cdsco_pdf.last_counts | null, degraded}.

DiffOk.Comment: $.diff.degraded == true (meta row unreadable) goes to RecordFailure; otherwise Publish.

Publish.Comment: cdsco_publish.handler (success path, no $.error): write meta#cdsco_pdf ok=true with counts (normalise counts + rows_in/notices_out), last_run {run_id, month, pdf_url, pdf_s3_key, method, fallback_used, diff}, ingested (+ this PDF, deduped by pdf_url) and the kept listing; write ingest#<run_id> step publish/done. Output {published: true, meta_pk: 'meta#cdsco_pdf', counts, diff}. {published: false} (its own bookkeeping failed, degraded: true) -> Failed via the Published choice, never Done.

Published.Comment: The run counts as published only when Publish says so: $.publish.published == true -> Done; anything else (published: false, a degraded bookkeeping step) -> Failed, so a SUCCEEDED execution always means meta#cdsco_pdf ok=true.

RecordFailure.Comment: Failure path: the same Publish Lambda sees either $.error ({Error, Cause} from a Catch) or a step result with degraded: true (cdsco_publish._degraded_step scans $.fetch/$.extract/$.normalise/$.diff) and writes meta#cdsco_pdf ok=false (error, listing/ingested kept) plus ingest#<run_id> step publish/failed, returning {published: false, error}. Then Failed. If even this fails, go to Failed directly.

Done.Comment: The run is published: the feed, GET /v1/notices?source=cdsco_nsq and GET /ingest/status/{arn} reflect it.

Failed.Cause: A task failed or came back degraded; see $.error / $.<step>.error (recorded on meta#cdsco_pdf and ingest#<run_id> by RecordFailure)
